description: Returns the members of a team with their id, name and role (owner, admin, facilitator, member). Use the id as assign_to in retro.actions.create, retro.actions.update and retro.board.suggested_actions.promote. This is the team roster, the same one people see in team settings — it says nothing about who wrote which card. Pass team_id when several teams are available; with a single team it can be omitted.

team_id.description: Team to list members for. Required when more than one team is available — call retro.teams.list first.

name: retro.team.members.list
title: List Team Members Tool
